blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Private transfer to the airport and a flight to northern Chile.

On arrival, meet your driver and transfer to San Pedro de Atacama.

In the afternoon, a group excursion with a professional English-speaking guide to Moon Valley and Death Valley, about 8 km from San Pedro de Atacama.

The highlight is sunset in Moon Valley, followed by the return to San Pedro de Atacama.

**Night-time astronomical tour in the Atacama**

An optional group astronomical tour with an English-speaking guide offers a chance to observe the night sky through professional telescopes. Not available around the full moon.

**Astronomical tour price:** $100 per person.

Overnight at the hotel.
